chunks: Al-Shaykh, may Allah the Exalted support him, informed me from Abū Jaʿfar Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan, from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn Yaḥyā, from Abū Jaʿfar, from Abū al-Jawzāʾ, from al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿUlwān, from ʿAmr ibn Khālid, from Zayd ibn ʿAlī, from his forefathers, from ʿAlī عليه السلام:
That he was asked about a man who is burned by fire, so he instructed them: “to pour water over him thoroughly and that salat (prayer) be performed over him.”

key_terms.يُصَلَّى: the funeral salat (prayer) should be performed

ai.seo_question: What should be done for a person who has been burned by fire before funeral salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a deceased person whose body has been burned by fire. It indicates that water should be poured over him and that the funeral salat (prayer) should still be performed over him.
